preamble: Debuccalization of the voiceless retroflex fricative [ʂ] to the glottal fricative [h]. In Middle Indo-Aryan, Sanskrit ṣ sometimes appears as h in Prakrit, next to the usual reflex s: Sanskrit pāṣāṇa 'stone' > Prakrit pāhāṇa alongside pāsāṇa.

examples.note: A variant pāsāṇa, with the regular s reflex, also exists.

sources: Wiktionary. पाषाण (Sanskrit pāṣāṇa; Prakrit descendants pāsāṇa, pāhaṇa, pāhāṇa). https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/पाषाण
